# nycflights23

An R data package containing all out-bound flights from NYC in 2023 +
useful metadata

This package was created using the
[`anyflights`](https://github.com/simonpcouch/anyflights) R package. It
is used in the updated 2nd edition of the [ModernDive
textbook](https://moderndive.com/v2).

### Installation

------------------------------------------------------------------------

On CRAN, the package is available via

``` r

install.packages("nycflights23")
```

To install the current developmental version of `nycflights23`, make
sure to install `remotes` first.

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("moderndive/nycflights23")
```

# Package index

## Datasets

- [`airlines`](https://moderndive.github.io/nycflights23/reference/airlines.md)
  : Airline names.
- [`airports`](https://moderndive.github.io/nycflights23/reference/airports.md)
  : Airport metadata
- [`flights`](https://moderndive.github.io/nycflights23/reference/flights.md)
  : Flights data
- [`planes`](https://moderndive.github.io/nycflights23/reference/planes.md)
  : Plane metadata.
- [`weather`](https://moderndive.github.io/nycflights23/reference/weather.md)
  : Hourly weather data
